models.Baseline (without signal reliability): Learned detector — trained end-to-end on HaluEval (same encoder pipeline without signal-reliability branch; outputs P(hallucination))
models.Proposed (with signal reliability): Our method — learned detector with semantic + uncertainty cues and SignalReliabilityAnalyzer (outputs P(hallucination))
models.SummaC (published consistency): Published external baseline — SummaC NLI-based document–summary consistency (Laban et al.); mapped to P(hallucination) via val-split normalization (see run_summac_baseline.py)
